title: The Fire Beneath the Bronze

config.brief: Create a practical independent short-film adaptation of this Troy story. Filming region and actual cast availability are not yet chosen; do not invent them.

breakdown.title: The Fire Beneath the Bronze
breakdown.summary: An independent short-film adaptation of the Troy story following smith Thestor and his nephew Meles as they bargain for passage home, travel to the sanctuary at Cape Lekton to recover iron tubes and charges, and witness the weapons’ first use at the Scamander ditch. The arc moves from a windswept Myrmidon beach camp through a cliff sanctuary exchange to a rain-soaked battlefield and a quiet aftermath at the ships, emphasizing practical craft, negotiation, and cost.
visual_criteria: Gravel shingle beach with damp sand, charcoal trenches, overturned troughs and goat-hair blankets; muted gray kelp, broken timber, overcast morning light
Beached merchant coaster on wet rollers with cedar skids, Ithacan rowers and casks; desaturated sea palette with wind-blown dust
Rocky cliff path with grey silt, narrow ledges, spray and sail-strips for foot binding; high contrast daylight with white spray
Limestone sanctuary interior with fallen lintel, smoke-darkened roof, anvil stone and wooden stand; warm hearth glow against cool stone
Open camp on shingle under red-prowed flagship; cedar rack, bronze basin with crossed tools stamp; bright midday sun and hard shadows
Rain-soaked ditch bank with mud, shields, smoke haze and blue wool strips; low overcast, diffused wet palette

scenes.title: Bronze on the Shingle
scenes.location: gravel beach south of Myrmidon shelters with charcoal trenches
scenes.description: Dawn wind dies over kelp-strewn shingle. Thestor works bronze steering braces on an anvil stone while Meles sits on an overturned trough with possessions. Thestor finds a hollow bronze sleeve in seaweed, uncovers mallet and tongs stamp.

scenes.title: Bargain on the Skids
scenes.location: beached merchant coaster on shingle with Ithacan rowers
scenes.description: Odysseus with spearmen checks casks. Thestor offers refitted rudder box for Meles’ passage and barley. Odysseus refuses, then Thestor reveals the bronze sleeve. Odysseus offers barley and passage for a trip to Lekton.

scenes.title: Skiff to Lekton
scenes.location: rocky silt landing at Cape Lekton with cliff climb
scenes.description: Skiff grounded on grey silt. Crew haul boat, climb narrow path. Thestor carries sleeve under cloak, rower loses sandal. Leather around bronze soaks through.

scenes.title: Sanctuary Exchange
scenes.location: inland limestone sanctuary behind fallen lintel
scenes.description: Keeper with white-clouded eyes and bronze tokens demands return of stolen basin. Odysseus recalls basin used by Agamemnon. Odysseus offers seal ring for temporary return of basin. Ring placed under altar.

scenes.title: Weapons Revealed
scenes.description: Keeper uncovers six iron tubes on frames and chest of twenty-five charges. Count with counters. Demonstration shot on fallen block. Smoke clears to scar.

scenes.title: Return to Camp
scenes.location: cliff descent to skiff and shingle camp
scenes.description: Crew rig sail slings, carry tubes and chest down narrow ledge. Odysseus braces load. Tide returns, hull lifted. Arrival at camp under Agamemnon’s flagship.

scenes.title: Trial Before the King
scenes.location: shingle under red-prowed flagship with cedar rack
scenes.description: Agamemnon places token on rack. Achilles watches. Thestor prepares tube, Meles holds linen. First shot splinters oak target, burns Thestor’s wrist. Thestor demands passage recorded before further use.

scenes.title: Ditch in Rain
scenes.description: Rain flattens grass. Achilles shields operators. Thestor crouches by frame, Meles holds chest on stones. First three shots fire at Hector’s line, smoke spreads.

scenes.title: Frame Collapse
scenes.description: Packets spill into rain, black stroke runs. Fourth charge hisses, no shot. Frame tips, breaks collar, tube falls across Meles’s leg. Thestor cuts sling, tube plunges into water.

scenes.title: Shield Rescue
scenes.description: Achilles drops into trench, drives shield into clay, forces Trojan back. Myrmidons lift brace, Thestor draws Meles out. Trojans withdraw toward oak.

scenes.title: Aftermath at the Ships
scenes.description: Healer treats Meles’s leg, saves boy but not foot. Thestor sits with burned hand, gives unworn tunic for cloth. Meles packs for homeward ship.

scenes.title: Tally and Basin
scenes.location: Agamemnon’s meal area with bronze basin
scenes.description: Odysseus carries weapon count to Agamemnon. Attendant pours water into broad bronze basin with crossed tools stamp. Odysseus places unringed hand through handle.

recommendations.summary: The Fire Beneath the Bronze is a 12-scene independent short set in a story-world Troy with a 5-day tentative shoot starting 2026-11-02 America/Chicago, skipping weekends. No filming region, venues, cast availability, vendors or rates have been chosen. All budget items are zero/unknown and all permit, insurance and access requirements remain unverified as of research date 2026-10-24. Scene minutes are shooting estimates, not screen time, and assume a 10-hour day with 30-min setup, 45-min moves and 15% contingency. Visual criteria are scouting guidance only and do not prove a real address, permission, accessibility or availability. Story-world geography must be distinguished from any actual filming region.
